verdict.rationale: Next.js's own site advertises pre-built starter solutions from Vercel and the community. It also documents that the framework configures bundlers and compilers automatically, and a community MVP team cited "no tooling setup" as a benefit. However, the pack contains no evidence of an official scaffolding CLI or of a documented minutes-to-running workflow. Missing for 10: documented official scaffolding CLI (e.g. a create command), step-by-step quickstart showing time-to-running, hands-on corroboration of scaffolding speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and run a new project in just a few minutes using an official CLI or starter

citations.quote: Jumpstart your Next.js development with pre-built solutions from Vercel and our community.
It also automatically configures lower-level tools like bundlers and compilers.
They cited no tooling setup, SSR plus SPA rendering out of the box
